C0.quote: examines the representation and explicit description of social welfare orders on
C0.note: The paper studies social welfare orders over infinite utility streams of generations (intergenerational equity: anonymity and asymptotic Pareto axioms, representability and non-constructive nature). There are no voters, ballots or voting procedure; the objects ranked are utility streams evaluated by a planner, not agents' inputs aggregated by voting. Coding stopped per C0 rule.
